executive_summary: Rev A of DA1840189 (issued 10/16/25) introduces several significant geometry changes to this bracket/clamp block alongside a substantial drawing reorganization. Most critically, multiple fillet/radius additions are evident: slot opening interior corners on the rear face transition from sharp to radiused, the lower edge profile of the bracket gains fillets, and the left mounting boss blend geometry changes to a more pronounced S-curve transition — all of which affect stress concentration, machining toolpaths, and potentially fixture requirements. The R.030 pocket corner callout count is halved from 16X to 8X in Section C-C, requiring clarification as to whether corners were removed from the design or merely re-grouped under a different leader. The drawing set itself was substantially restructured: views VIEW_1, SIDE, and VIEW_8 were removed and replaced with a new FRONT view, Sections A-A, B-B, and C-C, and an ANNOTATION view, reflecting a more fully detailed second sheet; the revision block title field also lost its 'TS' designation, which should be confirmed as intentional. Minor documentation updates include replacing the brand-specific 'HELICOIL' callout with the generic 'HELICAL INSERTS' and updating all revision identifiers from NC to A.
